responsibility: Builds synthetic MIR bodies for compiler-generated shims and constructors. This file provides the `mir_shims` query and contains the logic to construct MIR for call adaptation shims (such as vtable, fn-pointer, reify, and closure-once shims), drop glue, clone shims, and ADT constructors, then runs the necessary cleanup and lowering passes so those generated bodies are valid, simplified MIR for later compilation stages.
